last.verdict: Kraft Heinz nudged its sales and EPS guidance up, but profit is still falling about 15% and shoppers are buying fewer of its products.

takeaways.label: Profit still shrinking
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M and adjusted EPS fell to $0.53 from $0.61. Costs for ingredients, shipping and bonuses, plus more advertising, outweighed savings.

takeaways.label: Guidance raise is thin
takeaways.text: The sales range narrowed to down 0.5% to 1.25% from down 0.5% to 2%, and EPS rose to $2.07-$2.13. Profit guidance is unchanged, and the EPS lift is helped by a lower tax rate and more other income.

takeaways.label: US shoppers buying less
takeaways.text: North America sales fell 3.4% on weaker meats, sauces and drinks, and volume fell 2.4%. Management says share and volume trends are improving versus last year, but the quarter still shows declines.

takeaways.label: Emerging markets the bright spot
takeaways.text: Emerging Markets organic sales rose 15.6%, while Europe and other developed markets saw adjusted operating income fall 32.8%. Growth abroad is not yet offsetting weakness at home.

history.verdict: Investors sold the stock as profit kept shrinking while spending on brands rose.

reasons.label: Profit falling sharply
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income fell 18.4% to $1.0B as advertising and costs rose.

reasons.label: Spending raised again
reasons.text: Extra 2026 brand investment rose $100M to about $700M, weighing on near-term profit.

reasons.label: Sales still shrinking
reasons.text: Sales fell 1.3% as meats and Lunchables-type products lagged; outlook only trimmed to down 0.5-2%.
